contributionMap.claim: The uncorrected phase-blind waiting-time estimate S_1 of Harunari, Fiore and Barato is not a lower bound on entropy production, and its excess is unbounded (three-state zero-current example; S_1 > 31 sigma by exact rational certificate, > 145 sigma by certified lag bins)
